from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_definition import Cut
from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_functions import get_nObj_eq, get_nObj_min
from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import MultiCut, CartesianSelection, StandardSelection
from pocket_coffea.parameters.cuts import passthrough

# Binning 1: jet multiplicity (JetGood) -> exactly 4, exactly 5, at least 6
jet_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    name="Njet",
    cuts=[
        get_nObj_eq(4, coll="JetGood", name="4j"),
        get_nObj_eq(5, coll="JetGood", name="5j"),
        get_nObj_min(6, coll="JetGood", name="6j"),
    ],
    cuts_names=["4j", "5j", "6j"],
)

# Binning 2: b-tag multiplicity (BJetGood) -> exactly 2, at least 3
btag_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    name="Nbjet",
    cuts=[
        get_nObj_eq(2, coll="BJetGood", name="2b"),
        get_nObj_min(3, coll="BJetGood", name="3b"),
    ],
    cuts_names=["2b", "3b"],
)

# Cartesian product of the two binnings -> 3 x 2 = 6 categories:
# 4j2b, 4j3b, 5j2b, 5j3b, 6j2b, 6j3b
categories = CartesianSelection(
    multicuts=[jet_multiplicity, btag_multiplicity],
    common_cats=StandardSelection({"baseline": [passthrough]}),
)

cfg = {
    "categories": categories,
}
